newsitem.title: IRAQ: Saddam to deliver speech marking end of Iran war.
newsitem.headline: Saddam to deliver speech marking end of Iran war.

text.p: Iraqi President Saddam Hussein will deliver on Friday a televised speech marking the ninth anniversary of the end of the 1980-1988 Iraq-Iran war, the Iraqi News Agency INA said on Thursday.
"The president leader Saddam Hussein will deliver an important speech at 11 a.m (0900 GMT) on Friday on the ocassion of...the Great Victory Day," INA said.

The agency quoted Culture and Information Minister Hamed Youssef Hummadi as saying that Saddam would call on Iran to return back Iraq's civilian and military planes which Baghdad had sent to Tehran to escape the allies' bombing during the U.S.-led 1991 Gulf War which drove Iraqi troops out of Kuwait.
Relations between Tehran and Baghdad are strained by various issues including charges by each government that the other supports rebels bent on its overthrow.
